references.text: Later in the same account, the Lord opens Balaam's eyes so that he also sees the angel with the drawn sword, just as the donkey had seen.
The donkey reacts again to the Lord's angel and lies down under Balaam, showing that the animal repeatedly sees what Balaam cannot see.
Joshua meets a man with a drawn sword in his hand, who turns out to be the commander of the Lord's army - a similar revelation of a heavenly figure with a drawn sword.
David sees the Lord's angel standing between earth and heaven with a drawn sword pointed toward Jerusalem.
The Lord's angel with an outstretched hand toward Jerusalem, a parallel to the angel who stands in the way with a drawn sword.
The cherubim with the flaming sword that turns in every direction to guard the way to the tree of life - another heavenly figure with a sword blocking the path.
In John's Revelation, the Son of Man has a sharp double-edged sword coming out of his mouth, showing the power of God's word and judgment.
